preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair consists of two distinct integers between 1 and n (inclusive), and no pair is repeated.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= 0 and m <= n * (n - 1) // 2
preconditions.description: n is the number of horses (1 ≤ n), and m is the number of enemy pairs (0 ≤ m ≤ n(n-1)/2).

preconditions.expression: all(len(enemies) <= 3 for enemies in [set() for _ in range(n+1)] if (enemies.update({a, b}) or True) for a, b in (tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each horse has at most 3 enemies (enmity is symmetric and undirected).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no valid split exists) or a string of length n with characters '0' or '1', where the i-th character indicates the party (0 or 1) of horse i+1 (1-based).

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all((stdout[a-1] != stdout[b-1] or (stdout[a-1] == stdout[b-1] and sum(1 for x in range(n) if x != a and x != b and stdout[x] == stdout[a] and (x in {a, b} or (a, x) in enemy_pairs or (b, x) in enemy_pairs)) <= 1)) for a, b in enemy_pairs)
postconditions.description: For every enemy pair (a, b), either they are in different parties, or if they are in the same party, that party contains at most one other enemy of either a or b. Here, `enemy_pairs` is the set of all unordered enemy pairs parsed from input.
